info.title: DotnetAssemblyMcp.Cli
info.description: Human-driven CLI front-end for static .NET assembly navigation. Shares the same engine as the MCP server (dotnet-assembly-mcp) but is intended for direct terminal use rather than LLM-driven MCP calls.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Static navigation of compiled .NET assemblies — types, methods, attributes, references, and on-demand decompilation, straight from the terminal.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the full AssemblyResult envelope as indented JSON instead of human text. [default: False]

options.name: --load
options.description: Load an assembly into the index before the command runs. Repeatable.

commands.name: load
commands.description: Load a managed assembly and print its module summary. The CLI is stateless per-invocation, so a separate 'list-assemblies' run won't see it; to prime modules for another command, pass that command a '--load <path>' instead.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path (relative or absolute) to a managed PE assembly (.dll / .exe).

commands.name: list-assemblies
commands.description: List modules loaded in THIS invocation. The CLI is stateless, so this only shows modules primed on the same command line via '--load' (e.g. 'list-assemblies --load a.dll --load b.dll').

commands.name: import-manifest
commands.description: Bulk-register (mvid, path) pairs observed in a running process.

options.name: --entry
options.description: Manifest entry in '<mvid-guid>=<path>' form. Repeat for multiple modules.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Import mode: 'lazy' (default; record mvid->path) or 'tier1' (open eagerly). [default: lazy]

commands.name: get-method
commands.description: Resolve a method identity to its declaring type, name, signature and attributes.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path hint to the assembly so it can be auto-loaded if not already in the index.

options.name: --generic-arity
options.description: Generic arity from the producer payload.

options.name: --include-native-body
options.description: Probe for a precompiled ReadyToRun native body. [default: False]

arguments.name: MODULE_VERSION_ID
arguments.description: MVID GUID (or 'm:<mvid>:0x<token>' handle) of the declaring assembly.

arguments.name: METADATA_TOKEN
arguments.description: Method definition metadata token (decimal or 0x hex).

arguments.name: MVID_OR_PATH
arguments.description: Module MVID or absolute path to the assembly.

arguments.name: TYPE_FULL_NAME
arguments.description: Full type name ('+'-joined for nested types).

commands.name: explain-method
commands.description: Resolve a method by name and show each overload's signature, source location and (optionally) decompiled C#.

options.name: --contains
options.description: Match the method name by case-insensitive substring instead of exact. [default: False]

options.name: --decompile
options.description: Decompile each selected overload to C#. [default: False]

options.name: --max-chars
options.description: Per-method decompilation character cap (0 = engine default).

arguments.name: MVID_OR_PATH
arguments.description: Module MVID or absolute path to the assembly.

arguments.name: TYPE_FULL_NAME
arguments.description: Full declaring type name ('+'-joined for nested types).

arguments.name: METHOD_NAME
arguments.description: Method name to resolve (exact by default).

commands.name: callgraph
commands.description: Show who transitively calls a method: a recursive caller tree resolved by name.

options.name: --depth
options.description: Maximum caller levels below each root (root = level 0). Default 3. [default: 3]

options.name: --max-nodes
options.description: Hard cap on total rendered nodes across the whole forest. Default 200. [default: 200]

options.name: --contains
options.description: Match the method name by case-insensitive substring instead of exact. [default: False]

arguments.name: TYPE_FULL_NAME

commands.name: diff-assemblies
